name: Jellyfin Federation
overview: Allows jellyfin servers to federate with each other
description: This Jellyfin plugin allows multiple Jellyfin servers to federate, sharing media libraries in real-time without syncing or copying files. Media can be streamed from one server to another with live transcoding if necessary.

versions.changelog: Fix: federated items never showed up. Materialized items had Path set to a federation:// URI Jellyfin doesn't recognize, so it treated them as missing/offline everywhere - hidden from browsing and from the plugin's own dedup check, which silently recreated a full duplicate set every hour. Items are now identified by a FederationKey provider id instead, with Path left null (true Virtual item). Upgrading auto-cleans any legacy federation:// duplicates on the next sync, no manual steps needed. Also triggers a background sync 5s after server start so items appear without waiting for the first scheduled task.

Fix: virtual libraries now actually provision. Jellyfin's AddVirtualFolder requires real filesystem paths, so federation:// URIs were rejected. Now uses an empty shadow folder under the plugin data dir; same-name libraries merge into one. Removal only detaches the federation location from merged libraries.
Config page rewrite: sidebar link, guided setup, working buttons, auto-detect public URL. Same-name libraries across servers merge into one. Advanced settings collapsed by default.
